newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek brokers' market shares in February - SMEHA.
newsitem.headline: Greek brokers' market shares in February - SMEHA.

text.p: February trading volume at the Athens bourse reached 858.02 billion drachmas, up 62 percent on January's 528 billion, The Athens stock exchange members association (SMEHA) said on Wednesday.

The monthly market share rankings showed Alpha Brokerage leading the exchange's 63 brokers with 7.97 percent, followed by Telesis Securities, 7.03 percent, Devletoglou Securities, 6.76 percent and Sigma Securities with 6.43 percent.
Cumulative January-to-February 1997 trading volume reached 1.38 trillion drachmas compared to 3.97 trillion in the entire 1996.

SMEHA released the following data and market share rankings for February. The top 15 brokers shared 59.9 percent of the bourse's trading volume. The remainder went to the exchanges other 47 member brokers.
